**Sources (primary, this session):** TXN Q2'26 8-K (2026-07-22, accession 0000097476-26-000148) — revenue/EPS/segments/CFFO/capex/dividends; Q2'26 10-Q (filed 2026-07-24, accession 0000097476-26-000152) — inventory days, China revenue split, capex guide; dossier data/dossiers/TXN.md (asof 2026-07-21).

**EARNINGS_QUALITY gate:** Accruals (NI−CFO)/avg assets: FY25 −6.1%, H1'26 CFO $4.22B vs NI $3.53B (CFO/NI 1.2x) — cash conversion rising, no flag. AR +$557M vs revenue +$1.77B (H1) — in line. Inventory DOWN $199M to $4.61B; days 196 (vs 222 YE25), inside the 150-250 band — no divergence. Structure: EY auditor; no going-concern, anti-dumping or export-control language found in the Q2'26 10-Q (searched). Related-party: none found. Gate clears.

**Revenue build (FY26E ≈ $22.3B, +26% YoY):** H1'26 actual $10,288M + Q3 guide midpoint $5.90B + Q4 ~$6.10B. FY27-29E +9/+7/+6% as the snap-back decelerates. Segment margins (Q2'26 actual): Analog rev $4,365M (+26%) at 45.6% OM; Embedded $788M (+16%) at 21.3% — vs FY25 38.6%/11.3%. Model consolidated OM 41.0% (FY26E) fading to 44.0% (FY29E), short of the FY21-22 ~49-51% peak.

**FCF (load-bearing mechanism):** FY26E CFO ≈ $9.9B (TTM CFO/revenue 44.6%, 8-K) − capex $2.5B (guided $2-3B) + CHIPS $1.4B (H1 actual $1.10B) ≈ $8.8B = **$9.6/share** ($8.1 ex-CHIPS) — above mgmt's $8+ guide on a conservative build. FY27E FCF ≈ $10.1-10.5/share (rev $24.3B × 44.6% − 12.5% capex + CHIPS + Silicon Labs $450M synergies).

**DCF (house 9% COE, tg 2.5%, terminal ROIC 20-25%):** fair ≈ $119-150/share pre-SLB ($111-142 post-SLB). EV/EBIT FY26E ~13x. Reinvestment ≈ 20% of NOPAT at ~32% ROIC → self-sustaining g ≈ 6%: growth is manufactured, not declared.

sections.heading: Priors disclosure
sections.detail: one sentence, from memory, written before document work
sections.markdown: What I believe the market narrative is: TXN is a quality analog/embedded compounder whose FCF "harvest" (capex down, $8+/share FCF) is real but fully priced after a big 2026 re-rate, with China's anti-dumping probe and AI-trade froth capping further upside.

sections.heading: Variant perception
sections.markdown:
**Market believes:** the FCF recovery is a one-time capex unwind; TXN is an expensive slow compounder with a disqualifying China overhang — the 7/13 valuation kill at $311 was fair, and the 12.6% pullback merely corrects froth.

**Why wrong:** the FCF inflection is structural, not a one-off. Capex is permanently ~10-15% of revenue (mgmt framework, 10-Q) after the 300mm buildout; CFO margin is a durable ~45% (8-K TTM). Q2'26 confirms with a primary print: TTM FCF $6.5B rising toward my $9.6/share FY26E (above the $8+ guide), Analog OM 45.6% (300mm cost moat widening, not peaking), inventory days 196 (channel clean). The market under-weights the AI analogue: data-center power grew ~90% YoY (dossier) — an AI-infrastructure franchise still priced like a cyclical. China is not yet the killer the prior kill assumed: Q2 China revenue +24% YoY to 22% of total, with no probe impact disclosed. At $272 the market pays ~28x FY26E EV/EBIT and ~30x FY27E EPS — a quality-compounder multiple, not a bubble, on a ~10% FCF grower at ~32% ROIC.

**What proves us wrong:** Q3/Q4'26 prints with FCF/share below the ~$9 run-rate; a MOFCOM preliminary dumping ruling with material share loss; inventory days breaking >250; or the FCF multiple compressing toward the DCF zone (~$120-150) — the $212 momentum-structure kill fires first on that last path.

sections.heading: Disconfirming facts
sections.detail: >=3, observable, current, each citing a dossier/filing line
sections.markdown:
1. China is 22% of Q2'26 revenue by end-customer HQ (Q2'26 10-Q geographic note) under an active Sept-2025 MOFCOM anti-dumping probe naming TI (dossier; Reuters/SCMP coverage); an adverse preliminary ruling could accelerate documented analog localization (16% in 2024, rising).
2. At $272 the stock trades ~28x FY26E EV/EBIT and ~30x FY27E EPS — a rich quality multiple; the semis_ai factor (stress −9%) means any growth miss hits disproportionately hard (screen row 2026-08-19).
3. Buybacks have nearly ceased (Q2'26 $27M; TTM $707M vs $5.1B dividends — 8-K), concentrating cash return in a dividend the H1'27 Silicon Labs $7.5B cash close will run alongside; a dividend cut would de-rate the "safe compounder" multiple violently.

sections.heading: Pre-mortem
sections.markdown: It is mid-2027 and this 9-month momentum position lost ~22% to the $212 kill. Most likely cause: the FCF re-rate stalled as Q3/Q4'26 revenue decelerated harder than my +9% FY27 fade, the ~28x EV/EBIT multiple compressed toward the DCF zone (~$120-150) as AI-semis sentiment cooled, and a MOFCOM adverse preliminary ruling gapped the stock through the momentum-structure kill — a left tail the −22% base-rate down_pct does not fully cover. The kill fires on structure, not fair value; the compensation is small size.
